Validation round v1: OUT-OF-SAMPLE test of resource models fitted on 80 probes (rounds 1-4 + reconstructable 2026-11-06 jobs; fit data sha256 prefix 3a50f30f1a538049, modelfit.py).
Registered before submission (no external timestamp). Outcome = accepted (P) or error 6057 (F). Counts are taken from the transpiled circuits (asserted equal to the builder).
Frozen models:
  M_w (weighted pool): fail iff 4*peak_live_registers + 5*left_to_right_stack_need >= 59  (fitted on 80 probes, 2 errors; pass max 58, fail min 59)
  M_u (unweighted pool): fail iff peak_live + stack need >= 14 (best unweighted threshold, 9 errors)
  M_peak (peak live registers): fail iff peak live registers >= 13 (13 errors)
  M_cone (measured registers in cone): fail iff distinct measured registers in the cone >= 12 (15 errors, falsified by staged)
  M_SU (Sethi-Ullman pool): fail iff peak live + Ershov number >= 15 (12 errors)
  M_ops (op limit): fail iff a store has >= 103 ops or the cone >= 104 ops (falsified by bal104/chain104)
  Known misfits of M_w: old 2026-11-06 T3 (6 stored BDD expressions in bit variables) and T3m predicted pass, observed fail; W512 handled by a separate bit-variable pool (>= 513 live stored bits).
